WITH transaction_trader_counts AS (
  SELECT tr.tradereg, tr.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT ab.translink) AS transaction_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref
  GROUP BY tr.tradereg, tr.tradekind
), pair_shares AS (
  SELECT tradekind, transaction_count,
         transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS transaction_share
  FROM transaction_trader_counts
)
SELECT tradekind,
       AVG(transaction_count) AS avg_count_per_pair,
       AVG(transaction_share) AS avg_share_per_pair
FROM pair_shares
GROUP BY tradekind;
